name: io.github.vassiliylakhonin/vizier
title: Vizier
description: Check owner-signed permissions before AI agent actions; ALLOW/BLOCK/REVIEW and request-bound receipts.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <integration credential>. Optional: an anonymous call returns an evaluation-only decision that never grants ALLOW, and enforcement requires the server delegation policy, including a signed principal grant in required mode.
